leakage_controls: Training labels require target_date < asof (fully matured before prediction).
Features use only active-series history through asof; Kalman/rolling windows are causal.
Fundamental panel columns are forward-filled from prior releases only.
Macro factors from offline public proxies (METHANOL_MACRO_OFFLINE).
No fundamental_overlay calibration in walk-forward (matches research backtest).
Actual outcomes use precomputed future closes for matured rows only; unmatured marked false.

notes: 价格 / K 线优先取 cache/methanol_tradeable_contract_active_series.csv（主力连续 OHLC）。
Walk-forward：每个 asof 仅用 target_date < asof 的已到期标签训练（causal_training_view / fit_asof），无未来 bar 泄漏。
未到期 T+1/T+5 标记 matured_*=false；图上目标价仅对已到期或 asof≤最新收盘的预测展示命中态，未到期不标注真实结果。
宏观因子走 METHANOL_MACRO_OFFLINE 公共代理；Walk-forward 不含 fundamental_overlay（与研究回测一致）。
